 RJ Balaji wishes Mookuthi Amman 2 'blockbuster success'
 Fri, 06 November 2026 
 Share: 
 15:16 
 Photograph: Kind courtesy RJ Balaji/Instagram 
 Actor-director RJ Balaji recently wished the team of Mookuthi Amman 2 as the film released in theatres today.
The former radio jockey shared a picture with the lead actor Nayanthara along with her husband Vighnesh Shivan on Instagram and extended his best wishes to the team.
'Wishing my favourite, the evergreen Nayanthara a blockbuster success with #MookuthiAmman2,' Balaji wrote.
He also wished producer Ishari K Ganesh and director Sundar C. 
 Reposting the message in her Instagram story, Nayanthara wrote: ' Annanaeeeee (meaning brother) Thank uuuu for the love and blessings.'
RJ Balaji directed the first installment of Mookuthi Amman  which released in 2020. Nayanthara played the title role. Mookuthi Amman 2  directed by Sundar C features Nayanthara in a double role along with Regina Cassandra, Urvashi and Yogi Babu in supporting roles.
